# Deployments

Every deployment of the Gluon reactor contract, with its contract address and the parameter values it
was deployed with. This file is generated from `deployments/<network>.json` by
`node scripts/render-deployments.ts`; do not edit it by hand. When you deploy, tag the deployed
version in git; the bootstrap script records the deployment.

Transaction [`42207ca4b198…`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.com/en/transactions/42207ca4b198e8f51852622b272e1f5fb183b84b10d95ee141c5cb85d8496f28) migrated the reactor to the gluon-gold-v2 contract at height 1397587.

Created by migrating the gluon-gold-pre-v2 reactor: the genesis transaction spent its last box (`2c89f574973a…`) and recreated it under this contract with the same reserve, tokens and registers, except for a new treasury key in R5. The reactor NFT, neutrons and protons are therefore those of gluon-gold-pre-v2. The oracle buyback NFT `119a068a0119…` was burned at height 1818488 (2026-06-30), and this contract requires the oracle-fee output of a beta decay to hold it, so beta decays that owe an oracle fee can no longer be built; fission and fusion are unaffected.

Its contract was compiled on branch `ldgaetano/gluon-usd` of the StabilityNexus fork, which this repository does not include: it is the contract of commit `2329331` without the checks on the oracle-fee output's script, so its tree has no `_OracleFeePk`. Its neutrons and protons have 3 decimals.
